Package dk.sdu.imada.teaching.compiler.fs25.vvpl

Class ErrorMessage

java.lang.Object
dk.sdu.imada.teaching.compiler.fs25.vvpl.ErrorMessage
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparable<ErrorMessage>
public class ErrorMessage extends Object implements Comparable<ErrorMessage>
This class represents an error message with line number, error type and message. It implements the Comparable interface for efficient sorting and overrides the toString method for easy reporting in the format: "invalid input: '<'error-type>, line "
